rows.en: (...Th-this... is brutal...)
rows.notes: Female only; after Hilda orders 20 laps.

rows.en: I'm sorry! I'll apply myself from now on!
rows.notes: Female only; answers Hilda asking if the player takes her class seriously.

rows.en: (Haah... I never imagined it'd turn out like this...)
(I'd like to talk with Hilda-sensei, but...)
Hey. Sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Hilda, x14 across frd_hld_001-007, both genders.

rows.en: No, not that long...
rows.notes: Male only; answers Hilda's 'sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en: I see. Then let's get started right away.
Ah, I figured it'd come to that...

All right, that's it for today.
Do a light cool-down before you head off, got it?
Yes. Thank you very much.
Mm. Good. See you.
(So it ends up like this after all...)
(I'd like to have a chat with Hilda-sensei, but...)
No, not too long...
(Figures it'd end up like this...)

(If we're off campus, it won't turn into
'self-training' again... right?)
rows.notes: Male only. The player hopes an off-campus meeting will not become Hilda's training session; 'self-training' as in frd_gry_001.

rows.en:
Changing where you train is important.
It changes your mood and your awareness of your body.
All right, stretches first!

Don't 'uh... um...' me!
Where's your answer?
rows.notes: Hilda echoes the player's 'etto' (c05595, slice 75); the quoted part should match c05595's English.

rows.en:
Good, that's a proper answer!
Now loosen up. This is the most basic of basics,
so do it thoroughly.

Remember what I told you last time.
Just going through the motions is pointless!
(Oh well. Guess I'll do it...)
Hup!

Better than before, but still nowhere near it.
Come on, spread your legs and drop your hips!
Ah, I can't, no way, I'm gonna break!

Are you an idiot?! There's no way you'd break
from something this mild!
(Hilda-sensei... what she says and what she does...)
rows.notes: Both genders; trails off as the Japanese does (her 'painful but pleasant' rule vs. this).

rows.en: Ow, ow, ow... This is still brutal...

All right, that should do it.
Next up, running and strength training!
...Yes.
rows.notes: x5: also frd_she_008 (female) and scd_sms_703; neutral.

rows.en:
Don't forget to stay aware of how your muscles move!
Keep your head working too, and focus on your run!
(...Sigh. It's this again today, just as I thought...)

All right, that's it for today.
Better than last time, but you've got a long way to go.
Still, you've got talent. Keep at it every day.
rows.notes: Hilda. 'Soshitsu wa warukunai' (your aptitude isn't bad) as 'you've got talent'.

rows.en: Yes. Thank you very much.
(Hmm... it ends up like this after all...)

(If we're off campus, it won't turn into
'self-training' again... right?)
Huh?! What do you mean, start...?
(Guess I've got no choice...)
Heave-ho!
Ah, I can't! No way! I'm going to break!
Owww... This is still tough...
(...Sigh. It's this again today, huh...)
Yes! Thank you very much.
(Hmm... figures it'd end up like this...)

(Well, it'll probably be the same
no matter where we go...)
Ah, I thought so...
rows.notes: Both genders; after Hilda's 'let's get started right away'.

rows.en:
All right, that's it for today.
You're gradually getting better. Keep at it.
(Changing the place didn't help after all...)

(Well, it'll probably be the same
no matter where we go...)
(Changing the place didn't help after all...)

(Maybe here, of all places, it won't turn into
the same old thing...)

Hm? What are you mumbling about?
Come on, your usual stretches. Get them done, quick.
Yes!!

Mm, looks like you're catching on.
Sloppy words mean a sloppy mind.
Make a habit of answering properly.
Yes, understood!
rows.notes: x6, player in frd_hld_003-005 and scd_com_618.

rows.en:
All right, that's enough there!
You seem to be getting used to it. Not bad at all!
Yes, thank you very much!
rows.notes: x5: also Akimizu in scd_com_103; neutral.

rows.en: Now then, today it's swimming.

It works your whole body, so it's hard on you,
but the water pressure massages you and boosts
circulation. It's perfect for training.
I see.

All right, let's get started.
The idea is the same as running. Stay aware of
your muscles and swim with your whole body.

Swim like you're picturing every part moving,
from your fingertips to your toes!
That's it! Not bad!

Bwah! Abbagabbubbobbabbah!
(Yes! Thank you very much!)
rows.notes: Both genders; the player answers underwater (gibberish), translation in parentheses.

rows.en:
No talking in the pool!
Focus on nothing but swimming, got it?!

Mm, not bad at all.
Your daily training seems to be paying off.
Well then, maybe I'll go for a swim myself.
(Huh?)

Come on, race me!
The loser buys the drinks!
(Wait... I've already done a ton of swimming...)

Phew, looks like I win.
Still, a swim after so long feels great.
It cleanses the soul.
(Well, yeah, obviously...)
rows.notes: Male only; reacting to Hilda winning against an exhausted player.

rows.en:
Well, you worked quite hard today.
In recognition of that, I'll treat you today.
rows.notes: Hilda; she won the race (loser pays) but treats the player anyway.

rows.en: What, you have a problem with that?
No! Thank you very much!
Mm. Good.
(Maybe Hilda-sensei is actually kind of nice...)
Yes! Thank you very much!
Makes sense.
rows.notes: x6: female here, also frd_kgr_002 and frd_yui_101 (both genders); neutral.

rows.en: (I'm already close to my limit today...)
rows.notes: Female only; reacts to Hilda's race challenge.

rows.en: (Hilda-sensei's swimming was amazing...)
(Oh, lucky!)
(Maybe Hilda-sensei is actually kind of nice!)

uncertain: c05638: Hilda echoes the player's hesitation 'etto' from c05595 (slice 75, not yet translated when this was written); rendered 'Don't 'uh... um...' me!'. The quoted words should match c05595's English.
